summary: Baker County summit cab, built 1920 to 1923 per conflicting sources and gone by the 1940s; a few cable and glass remnants remain, reached on foot.

facts.status_note: Cab removed; a few guy cables and glass fragments remain, per Oregon Hikers and a 2023 trip report

staffing.status: Named lookouts in the sources from 1923 to 1946

access.note: Reached on foot up a trail from the Cornucopia Trail; the road beyond the trailhead is closed to public vehicles (2023 report). No closure at the summit found.

visit.trail_note: About 900 feet of climb from the Cornucopia Trail, just east of the Schneider Cabin

corrections.why: The April 1922 Oregonian item says the station would be established that summer, and a February 1923 item says the house would be erected. A 1920 build is hard to square with those; firelookout.com gives 1923.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register says 1920; Oregon Hikers says 1922; firelookout.com and the 1923 Forest Lookouts items point to 1923. 1923 is recorded as best supported, but the sources do not settle it.

firelookout.com says abandoned in 1945; Forest Lookouts shows a lookout in charge in July 1946; the 2023 trip report says removed in the 1940s. Recorded with the conflict noted. The register says the lookout is gone, with no date.

notes_for_editor: Build year (1920, 1922, 1923) and removal year (1945 vs 1946 staffing vs 1940s) are contested across sources. Remains are described by a 2023 blog and an Oregon Hikers guide, not a formal survey. Access marked public from a hiking route and a closed-road note; no closure or permit found. Brief's 1920 build date needs changing.
